records.title: Ascending nociceptive pathways drive rapid escape and sustained avoidance in adult Drosophila

decisions.notes: Publisher-deposited preprint text reports adult fly optogenetic avoidance and escape behavior alongside connectome and neural analyses (Results and Figs. 1, 2 and 6). These observations are protective behavior, not subjective pain or human SCS response.
